name: Grand Hyatt Doha
positioning: Grand Hyatt Doha Hotel & Villas: a resort with a private beach, pools and villas on the shoreline of West Bay Lagoon
best_for: Travelers who want a city stay with a private beach and several pools
Families wanting villas with kitchens or a Family Suite with a connecting room

facts.text: The hotel sits along the shoreline of West Bay Lagoon.
The resort has Arabian architecture and landscaped gardens.
The resort spans over 150,000 square metres.
The hotel is directly across from Lagoona Mall and near The Pearl-Qatar and Lusail City.
Rooms are designed with contemporary Arabian decor.
Each room has a balcony and a spa-like bathroom with an oversized tub and walk-in shower.
Club Access rooms include access to the private club lounge.
The Family Suite combines a one-bedroom suite with a connecting standard room.
Jaula Club & Spa is designed to echo the symmetry and splendor of a royal palace.
The fitness centre is open 24/7 and has outdoor areas with views of the gardens and the sea.
The hotel offers Camp Hyatt for children.
Monkey Tale is a beach-side lounge overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

highlights.text: The hotel has a 400-metre private beach.
The villas are adjacent to the hotel, have fully equipped kitchens and access to two swimming pools and the private beach.
Jaula Spa has a couples treatment room with a private jetted tub.
The Royal Suite has a private sauna and a 106-square-metre balcony.
The hotel has four outdoor pools and one indoor pool.

considerations.text: Hamad International Airport is 25.7 kilometres from the hotel.
Souq Waqif is about 6 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
